tasks.title: E14 in full from its design
tasks.brief: You are the only coder on epic E14 (Trends, environment and Chronos-2). Implement it in full from its product brief docs/product/tdd/E14.md and docs/SYSTEM.md (its module, ports and seams; this epic has no design): every section, and every R, V and D of its acceptance matrix with a test, including end to end tests on the real stack. docs/build/E14/PLAN.md and ticket_tasks in docs/build/E14/tasks.json describe one split of this work with briefs, tests and gates: use them as a guide and checklist; the design and docs/SYSTEM.md win where they differ. Build in this order: domain, application, adapters, api, user interface, and run your tests as you go. If an epic you depend on has no code yet, code against its port protocol and the kernel fakes (docs/SYSTEM.md section 10).

ticket_tasks.title: Deterministic hub trends and forecast orchestration
ticket_tasks.brief:
Read AGENTS.md, docs/SYSTEM.md and docs/requests/COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md first, in that order, then the remaining reads. This is a standalone E14 coder brief for the product brief, not an absent design. docs/tdd/E14.md, docs/requests/E14.md and E14 cold reviews were absent at planning. Do not create or edit a design. Recheck the tree and all docs/build/*/tasks.json before creating code; integrate existing owner work rather than overwrite it. Edit only owned_paths. These directories instantiate SYSTEM 4.1/4.3 and 6.1 ownership, since E14 has no section 13. Do not run git or edit another epic's files, product contracts, shared configuration, root pyproject.toml, AI-USE-LOG.md, runner or fixture. No em/en dashes or spaced hyphen used as a dash.

SYSTEM is mandatory by section: 5.1 IdFactory and require_id; 5.2 Clock, TimeInput, NormalizedTime, ClockCorrections and clock segments; 5.3 MissionClock and retained opaque versions; 5.4 Quantity, Unit, WireQuantity, ConvertedQuantity, PressureContext, UnitRegistry and WireUnitConverter; 5.5 ProblemError/StorageUnavailable and generated ErrorEnvelope on the wire (D5); 5.6 ConfigReleaseReader, ReleaseHandle, ReleaseCheck and atomic last-good activation; 5.7 UnitOfWork/ReadSnapshot, storage, audience, event and replication interfaces; 5.8 CommandIdentity, IdempotencyStore, CommandReceipts, ResultVisibility and pending intents; 5.9 AuditEntry; 5.10 Scheduler, AbsoluteDeadline, ElapsedDeadline, HealthState; 5.10.1 TaskInput, TaskQueue, TaskRunner, TaskLease, TaskResult, TaskHandler and TaskRegistration; 5.11 HubSettings/SettingSpec; 5.12 ModuleRegistry/register and static discovery. Never implement replacements. SYSTEM 6 supplies uv project isolation, generated models and import rules; 8.1 resolves seams, 8.3 object/field/purpose consent, 8.6 capture/storage failure handling, 9/10 dependencies and bounded kernel.testing fakes. D1/D3/D6/D12/D14/D17 override older examples. Neither forecast nor assistant can change safety state. All boundary quantities carry UCUM, no bare float crosses ports, and errors/logs/tasks contain no private text.

Before implementation release, require the coordinator to file/decide the applicable R1 to R5 from docs/build/E14/PLAN.md in docs/requests/E14.md and propagate exact signatures and effective schemas. Those requests are unfiled, not authority. E01's actual kernel, generated models, hub project and fakes are also absent. Code against an agreed protocol and E01 kernel fakes for component tests when a provider is not built, never a local provider copy. Do not turn missing signatures into invented DTOs, routes, tables, job kinds or test-only production branches. A prerequisite still absent is blocked work, not a skipped test or successful unavailable-only feature.

Write traced critical-path, property and regression tests first. Derive clinical fixture content from validated configuration in an explicit profile; independent expected outcomes cannot be calculated by the same implementation/configuration as the input. Demo/evaluation datasets live only in fixtures or eval, never runtime fallback or test-folder clinical seed copies. Use injected IDs/clocks and no network, devices or wall time in component tests. A storage/I/O/integrity error propagates, never becomes an optional-feature success. Current grants apply before use and publication. R1/R2/R3 define missing policy and bounds; do not guess them. All loops, pages, histories, inputs, outputs and calls are bounded through SYSTEM 5.11 with concrete maxima. Operational settings are not clinical configuration. Task inputs/releases/models stay pinned; invalid configuration keeps last good and never clears warnings. Report the AGENTS section 6 faults that apply, including primary removal, and missing evidence honestly.

All gates run from repository root using the indicated project/configuration. No permissive flags, filters hiding failures, zero-test success, skip/xfail or gate waiver. Commands are obligations after owner projects exist, not results already achieved. R5 must make the import/coverage/trace commands actually cover E14. Done requires the task's positive and negative tests, gates, typed handoff and evidence, followed by T3 full-stack acceptance, independent review, green CI and coordinator-recorded AI-use rows. Every bug fix reruns the full hub suite. Send an unowned change or new seam finding to the coordinator; do not edit outside ownership.

Build E14-01 and the hub side of E14-02/E14-03 only: the minimal crew_health.trends module with pure deterministic comparisons, authorized owner-port reads, accepted input/result storage after R3 defines its inventory, an adapter to the agreed worker boundary and registration through module.py. SYSTEM 4.3 (docs/SYSTEM.md:130) assigns this module. T2 owns the worker; T3 owns UI and real-stack evidence. E03 owns HowYouAreView composition and catalog/copy; E23 owns mission/sensor ingest, aggregation, quality checks, conversions and freshness; E15 owns episodes/Records; E06 owns camera selection; E08 owns band scoring; E12 owns tool handlers. Do not create copies of those mechanisms.

Implement docs/product/tdd/E14.md:17-27, docs/product/PRD.md:578-582 and docs/product/CONTRACTS.md:36-37. Parse generated Observation and Answer at boundaries; preserve patient_id, operator_id, mission_id, nullable episode_id/device_id/supersedes, code, Quantity, observed_at/entered_at/received_at, origin_mode, acquisition_method, quality_status, quality_rule_version and context (docs/product/api/schemas/observation.schema.json:12-121). Keep LIVE/REPLAY/SIM and every contracted quality/method enum, nullability and supersession. Use only actual accepted records and head answers. Unknown/declined is no numerical value, while zero is real. Failed/rejected attempts and unconfirmed report/band drafts cannot become usable history.

Consume E01 ObservationReader/AnswerQuery only after R-E01-17 consolidation (docs/tdd/E01.md:168-172; docs/requests/E01.md:181-256). Require explicit snapshot/session/patient/mission/origin with bounded complete history, lineage and clock provenance. E15 EpisodeFacts.get(uow, episode_id) is existing but cannot enumerate exclusion periods (docs/tdd/E15.md:401); R1 must supply its authorized period reader. E23 SensorSeriesReader.accepted(channel_id, until, limit) -> SeriesSlice is declared in docs/tdd/E23.md:475-496, but its snapshot/IDs/pressure/provenance completion is R1. Consume its accepted contract, not a competing protocol. Never read records_*, episodes_*, sensors_* or mission_* tables. IndicatorSummaryPort ownership is SYSTEM 4.4 (docs/SYSTEM.md:153); its methods/DTOs remain X-E03-16 (docs/requests/E03.md:83-87), not defined by this brief. Publish only the settled R1 DTOs in trends/application/ports.py, with Quantity-bearing domain mappings. No shared type is hand-written from wire memory.

Read indicator-catalog.json through SYSTEM 5.6: label, unit_display, decimals, body_region, trend_days, baseline.method (median/mean), baseline.window_days, baseline.min_samples/basis and better (docs/product/api/schemas/config-indicator-catalog.schema.json:13-91). E03 owns the runtime file (docs/build/E03/tasks.json T1); read, do not edit. R2 must supply the versioned cohort/exclusion/eligibility policy and state/range semantics; existing display units or baseline.basis cannot substitute. Group by subject/mission/origin and the required rest/posture/gravity/device/method/operator context; exclude current reading, unresolved episode intervals and disallowed samples, preserving included IDs/reasons/policy/version. No cross-origin/person pooling, unknown-context matching, cherry-picking conflicts or silent averaging. Corrected sleep versus confirmed estimate and extra indicators follow docs/tdd/E03.md:544-555 only after its scale/lineage bindings are agreed. Missing E08 permits self-report/manual history, not invented sleep. Insufficient history remains insufficient. No new clinical formula or metric registry; R-E12-9 is outside these three work packages.

Map inputs/results to E03's agreed IndicatorSummaryPort. HowYouAreView indicators carry code/label/today/usual/delta_text/state/trend/extra/origin_mode/source_label/body_region; states within_usual/below_usual/above_usual/no_baseline/no_reading and nullable usual/trend values remain exact (docs/product/api/schemas/how-you-are-view.schema.json:19-137). Do not infer numeric precision, clinical ranges or a current value from that display schema. UI strings use E03 copy via TemplateRenderer; missing comparison never means normal. No forecast property is added to HowYouAreView.

For habitat, retain E23 origin, original dataset date, freshness, unit conversion and measured/assumed pressure with source. No subject Observation/exposure derives from habitat series. Use SYSTEM 5.2 D14 only for replay freshness; stopped, duplicated, looped or restarted nonadvancing playback never becomes fresh. SIM scenario linkage is explicit, not a fallback or LIVE exposure. E23 owns pressure conversion under SYSTEM 5.4; never assume 760 or recalculate its windows.

For forecasts, R3 must publish the missing Forecast schema, table/migration names, wire operations and worker boundary before persistence/API implementation. Baseline and Forecast exist only as semantic names in CONTRACTS 2, not generated resources. No E14 table or forecast operationId is currently available to copy, so none is specified here. Register the approved task handler and operation identities through SYSTEM 5.12. Use TaskInput.public_kind=None and no result_projector, immutable owner-held bounded input snapshots and keyed sensitive fingerprints, one stable forecast/task identity, pinned input revisions/release/model/version and accepted lineage. Refresh reconnects; it cannot submit duplicate work. R3 settles task admission/creation and forecast reads. E20 supplies its resource permit; no local resource arbiter. Execute outside UOW, validate finite typed results, then apply under current grant and live task generation. Cancellation, expiry, changed inputs or revoked access cannot publish late work. Never catch storage/config/auth/input errors as worker failures. Use the shared retry/lease mechanism only. No safety mutation port is required or exposed by trends. New local changes are reference-audited and declare explicit local-only replication until a projection is accepted; no unapproved export/event.

Tests first inside hub/tests/trends: E14-01/R11/R12 golden mean/median/current-exclusion/minimum-count and cohort cases, with independent arithmetic expected values; property tests for empty/zero/negative/boundary/nonfinite/unit mismatch, stable ordering, duplication and supersession; absence of valid context/exclusion policy gives unavailable. Verify qualified scale and corrected/confirmed sleep lineage, no rejected values, no cross-person/mission/origin contamination (V07/V09/V31/V47,D02/D09). Temporal tests cover same raw timestamp in different clock segments, retrospective correction, unknown/future time, late input, mission boundary and retained version (SYSTEM 5.2/5.3,V14). E14-02/V10/V72/D01/D16 tests assert dated replay/place-only context and explicit pressure, unknown pressure rejection, stopped/looped/restarted replay, and no personal evidence. Configuration edit test changes a sourced scratch catalog label/window/min_samples without code change or safety mapping edit, and invalid activation retains last good/pins/warnings (AGENTS 1.1,V75).

Forecast application tests use only the agreed worker protocol and kernel.testing at the optional boundary, covering crash before/after submit/claim/stage/complete/ack, retries after cache expiry with full operation/target/body identity, concurrent submissions/corrections, lease expiry/cancel/revocation versus completion, changed model/release, time jumps, storage/disk/audit failures and stale backlog. Never fabricate a worker result in production. V32/R12 asserts no route from forecast/assistant to warning/urgency mutation; a healthy baseline survives absent worker/weights/permit. Privacy tests deny another crew/station/officer without grants and keep journal/report draft/private text out of every query/log/cache/task (AGENTS 1.7,V25/V26). T3 supplies real HTTP/browser proof for all of these, including primary-removal safety fallbacks. Done means all positive policies are implemented against propagated R1/R2/R3, registered module discovery and strict gates pass, and T3 can consume the typed interfaces. Safe disabled comparisons/forecasts do not complete E14-01/03.
gates: uv run --project hub pytest -c hub/pyproject.toml -q hub/tests/trends --cov=crew_health.trends.domain --cov=crew_health.trends.application --cov-branch --cov-fail-under=95
uv run --project hub ruff check --config hub/pyproject.toml hub/src/crew_health/trends hub/tests/trends
uv run --project hub ruff format --check --config hub/pyproject.toml hub/src/crew_health/trends hub/tests/trends
uv run --project hub mypy --strict --config-file hub/pyproject.toml hub/src/crew_health/trends hub/tests/trends
uv run --project hub python -m crew_health.app.import_contracts --output /tmp/e14-imports.ini
uv run --project hub lint-imports --config /tmp/e14-imports.ini

Build only the isolated workers/forecast/ uv project assigned to E14 in docs/SYSTEM.md:130, :1647 and :1663 (distribution crew-health-forecast). T1 owns hub input selection, privacy, task/result persistence and generation validation; E20 owns process supervision, ports/network profiles, resource arbitration, image and offline bundle packaging. Do not create another hub, SQLite store, task runner, public Job endpoint or generic inference framework. SYSTEM 6.2 permits generated crew_health.contracts_gen wire models, not imports of hub kernel/platform/feature implementations. Domain quantities reach the worker only through the approved generated boundary codec, preserving UCUM and provenance.

Implement E14-03 (docs/product/tdd/E14.md:25-27), PRD numbers/resource rules (docs/product/PRD.md:578-588), temporal holdout requirements (docs/product/VALIDATION.md:233), SYSTEM 3/5.10.1/5.11/6 and DEPLOYMENT 3.1/7.3/7.4. No model artifact/version/hash, inference request/response/error/cancel contract, eligible cadence/horizon/interval-level policy, process package import name or admission protocol is specified in the current E14 sources. R2/R3 must publish these before worker implementation. Do not choose a model checkpoint, quantile levels, training window, random seed policy, medical range or settings document without that source. No runtime downloads or fallback synthetic outputs. Retain the pinned Chronos-2 weights and immutable software/model/config/input identifiers; do not train or alter weights. No medicine engine integration.

The specified worker interface currently includes only /health (docs/SYSTEM.md:63). Add no invented inference HTTP path or payload. After R3, implement exactly its generated boundary types, bounded admission, authenticated request/response and cancellation identity. Native listener uses the configured loopback; container private-network binding and per-service tokens follow DEPLOYMENT 7.3, never a published LAN worker. Expose health truthfully for ready, missing/corrupt artifact and unavailable resources without leaking patient inputs. Load/validate heavy weights once under startup/admission, not per request; optional artifact absence must not prevent the hub/manual baseline from running. Give E20 the agreed health/start/stop/resource contract rather than editing its files. Every request and subprocess uses registered bounds/timeouts, no local retry loop or unbounded queue. SYSTEM 3 seeds the 1.5 GB/two-core budget and pause while interactive model serves; operational values come from settings, never request literals.

Use only R2/R3-qualified regular contiguous histories. No resampling, interpolation across gaps, forward-fill or future-based imputation. Insufficient, invalid, stale, unknown-context or unqualified data is a typed unavailable response, never a guessed forecast. Preserve input IDs/order/times/units/origin and transform/method/model versions. All preprocessing uses development history only. R3 defines supported tensor conversion/precision and serialized output units; reject NaN/infinity, inconsistent length/timestamps/horizon/units and invalid interval ordering before a staged response. Experimental prediction intervals are never medical reference/safety limits or diagnoses. A worker cannot write chart observations, warnings or urgency. Task/generation cancellation belongs to E01; honor its external cancellation token and return only a staged result that T1 can validate. Stop/timeout/late response cannot publish records.

Tests first inside owned worker directory: E14-03/R12/R26 boundary parser property cases for empty/partial/nonfinite/malformed/oversized inputs, unit/origin/cadence mismatch, gaps and out-of-order times; deterministic transform tests and leakage test changing only holdout futures; fixed independently checked persistence/rolling comparators on identical splits and horizons (VALIDATION 233), no clinic-derived success threshold. Record denominators, history length, missingness, horizon, forecast errors and interval coverage including failures. Temporal ordering and all transforms are frozen before the held-out run. Do not rank models by repeatedly tuning the holdout.

Exercise missing/corrupt weights/hash, malformed worker output, resource denial, pause/resume and request cancellation/timeout; crashes before/after inference, duplicate task/generation requests, restarted process and late completion; bounds and all external call deadlines; zero artifact network access; current configured text/version change changes worker metadata/content without code change (AGENTS 1.1). No test edits a safety mapping. Wrong-type/unknown settings and corrupt configuration reject startup/activation rather than coerce/default. Persist no private request/history/log content; stderr and crash reports contain allowlisted codes/references. There is no worker database, clinical mutation, ground backlog or independent wall-clock safety rule, so shared acceptance, disk durability, authorization and unknown/degraded presentation remain T1/T3 responsibilities, exercised through the real hub.

Contract/inference tests may use the explicitly documented external fake for boundary faults after R3 defines it. At least one hermetic actual pinned CPU Chronos inference test, its deterministic comparator run and /health process test are mandatory. Lack of weights is blocked evidence, not skip/xfail or a successful fake forecast. T3 owns HTTP/browser V32, optional-worker primary removal and real-stack temporal result presentation. Give T3 the exact offline artifact identity and launch/health/error protocol. Record reference-laptop RSS/latency and pause/unload behavior through the E20 measurement interface; do not claim an unmeasured deployment envelope. Package only the minimal runtime needed by Chronos and its approved boundary.

Provide strict worker-local ruff/mypy/pytest and import-linter configuration in the owned project manifest under R3/R5. Import-linter must discover the actual approved worker package and forbid all hub implementation imports except generated wire models; a hub-only lint run cannot prove the worker boundary. Tests prove this contract rejects a forbidden import. Keep dependencies inside this project; root workspace edits are coordinator/E01 requests. Done means the real pinned artifact runs offline, fault/parser/temporal tests and all worker gates pass, E20/T1 can use the agreed boundary, and no optional worker failure affects safety or record entry. No invented package/type/route names fill the current R3 gap.

uv run --project workers/forecast ruff check --config workers/forecast/pyproject.toml workers/forecast
uv run --project workers/forecast ruff format --check --config workers/forecast/pyproject.toml workers/forecast
uv run --project workers/forecast mypy --strict --config-file workers/forecast/pyproject.toml workers/forecast
uv run --project workers/forecast lint-imports --config workers/forecast/pyproject.toml
